svg.title: Company profile MVP proposal for Aria ERP
svg.desc: An illustrative after mockup showing the existing Aria ERP admin shell with a company profile form on desktop and a 375 pixel mobile layout. The form includes a logo preview, legal and tax details, registered address, a required field validation error, and save actions.
svg.text: Illustrative UI proposal • Existing Aria ERP shell and settings patterns retained
